_note: Black holes for /explore v2 Slice 6. Three real (M87*, Sagittarius A*, Cygnus X-1) with cited parameters, one fictional (Gargantua, Kip Thorne's Interstellar model — badged fiction). Rendered with a geodesic gravitational-lensing shader. Placement: Sag A* reuses its S5 galactocentric spot; M87* + Cygnus X-1 by RA/Dec direction on the sky-sphere (like deep-sky); Gargantua is fictional, flagged. Masses in solar masses, distances in light-years, spin is the dimensionless a* (0..~1), rs_km is the Schwarzschild radius. inclination_deg is the disk tilt used for the render framing.

objects.name: Sagittarius A*
